name: Ichikoh Industries, Ltd.
summary: Ichikoh Industries, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and sells lamps and other automotive parts to automobile manufacturers and parts manufacturers in Japan and internationally. The company offers head, rear, head, and front combination lamps. It also provides automotive bulbs and wipers. In addition, the company manufactures and sells parts for electric vehicles. The company was founded in 1903 and is headquartered in Isehara, Japan. Ichikoh Industries, Ltd. is a subsidiary of Valeo Bayen S.A.
